entries.note: from SDK matrix tabular-data.json Built 2026-10-17: per-column summaries of a parsed table (kind, missing cells, distinct values, most common value, numeric min, max and mean), tests tabular_summary::tests. Still missing: a DataFrame or typed column storage, and column-aware JSON import and export, so the row stays partial. Built 2026-10-17: column-aware JSON (sdk tabular_json.rs) and typed columns (sdk tabular_columns.rs); tests tabular_json::tests, tabular_columns::tests. Built 2026-10-17: DataFrame over the typed columns (sdk tabular_frame.rs: from_table, from_columns, select, filter, sort_by, to_table; tests tabular_frame::tests) and tab-delimited reading (core csv parse_table_delimited; tests parity_sdk-complete-11). Still missing: a spreadsheet file reader or writer.
entries.ready_note: Typed columns and data frames, per-column statistical summaries, sorting, CSV reading and writing, and JSON import and export: bifrost_app::{tabular_frame, tabular_columns, tabular_summary, tabular_json, csv_writer} with core csv::parse_table. Host tests only.

entries.name: VisionKit
entries.note: Remaining from data file visionkit (refreshed 2026-10-17): No text recognition (OCR) for camera frames or images, so Live Text, DataScanner text and ImageAnalyzer have no counterpart. | Document scanning is an SDK model (sdk document_scan.rs: page corners to a flat page); the Camera app has no scanning mode. | No subject lifting or background removal for images. | Visual Look Up models exist (springboard/ui/src/visual_lookup.rs, look_up.rs, visual_search.rs) but no image lookup UI or service is wired into the shell or apps. | Barcode scanning is an SDK model (sdk data_scanner.rs), and the Camera app scans QR model 2 codes; no other barcode formats. | Plain-text data detection (controls::detect) has no image counterpart and does not cover transit information.

entries.name: VisualIntelligence
entries.note: from SDK matrix visual-intelligence.json Checked 2026-10-17: app return path, scene labels and crop selection exist as models (sdk visual_search, ui visual_search); system delivery of camera or screenshot scenes is not built. Refreshed 2026-10-17: not ready, remaining: No system delivery of camera or screenshot scenes to third-party apps (the core of the framework). | App return path is a model only: sdk visual_search::VisualSearchProvider answers a Scene with Matches, and search() stamps each match with the provider app id (tests in sdk/src/visual_search.rs); the shell does not call it yet. | Scene labels and pixels exist (ui visual_search::Scene::new, with_labels, pixel); the caller supplies the labels, nothing classifies the scene. | Object selection exists as Scene::crop(PixelRect) in ui visual_search; no screenshot UI feeds it yet. | App Intents are not exposed to a Shortcuts app or to a Siri-like assistant; entity queries are reachable only through the control socket and the Spotlight shortcut list.

entries.name: TCC
entries.note: private framework; settled in private frameworks wave 12 (see ready_note)

entries.name: TextAnimationSupport
entries.note: n/a: the bundle is a Metal shader library (default.metallib) for the shimmer and glow animation of the vendor's AI Writing Tools while it rewrites a selection, plus Info.plist and version.plist. It is a compiled GPU binary for a vendor-only effect; BifrOSt's proofreader (ui proofread) applies its suggestions inline without that effect, and BifrOSt's own text effects live in render motion.

entries.name: TextComposer
entries.note: private framework; settled in private frameworks wave 12 (see ready_note)
entries.ready_note: proofread_panel.rs opens a writing_assist Session over proofread findings and answers Accept, Skip and Accept All (suggestions move with each change). Notes: Proofread in the editor menu lists the suggestions of the selection or the note in the menu (Remove, Add, Change rows and Accept All); a row edits the note through its own editor so Undo works. Mail compose: Writing > Proofread, Accept Suggestion, Skip Suggestion and Accept All Suggestions; the suggestions are underlined in blue (thicker for the one in view), the status line says what it changes, and an edit of the message drops them. Host tests only; not verified on Midget. There is no right-click text context menu in the SDK text view or in these apps yet, so Proofread is in the apps' own menus; the English rules run on text without Icelandic letters (Mail) or text the language recogniser reads as English (Notes).

entries.name: ThumbnailsBlastDoorSupport
entries.note: private framework; settled in private frameworks wave 12 (see ready_note)
entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17: thumbnails of untrusted files are drawn on worker threads of the thumbnails service with size caps per provider (images, fonts, documents, PDF) and a decode allowance, and now a panicking decoder is contained (shell thumbnails contained) so a hostile file ends in a failed event and an icon, and the worker slot is released. BifrOSt decodes with memory-safe Rust code in the shell process; there is no separate sandboxed process like the reference's, so a decoder bug that does not panic is not isolated.

entries.name: Tightbeam

It is a vendor-only protocol for Apple's driver model; BifrOSt uses its own wire protocols (bifrost-wire, the privd protocol) and Linux drivers.

entries.name: TranslationAPISupport
entries.note: private framework; settled in private frameworks wave 12 (see ready_note)
entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17: the system translation popover for apps is the popover model (ui translation_popover), the presenter that checks the pair and calls the engine (sdk translation_popover) and now the drawing next to the selection (sdk widgets translation_popover: language pair, translation or Translating or the reason, wrapped with an ellipsis), with host tests including a drawing test. The app writes the replacement into its document.

entries.name: TranslationDaemon
entries.note: private framework; settled in private frameworks wave 12 (see ready_note) Lead 2026-10-17: not ready: no translation pair packages ship, so nothing translates out of the box.

entries.name: TranslationInference
entries.note: Runs Apple's neural translation models, which ship as Apple ML model packs and have no BifrOSt counterpart. BifrOSt translates with its own phrase-table language packs (sdk translation LanguagePack), so this framework's job is not reproduced.

entries.name: TranslationUI
entries.note: System translation presentation: the popover state (hidden, translating, result, failed), arrow-edge placement next to the selection, the language-pair check against installed packs, and the replacement text the app takes back.
entries.ready_note: The popover presenter (language-pair check, translation through the app Translator, placement with split::place_popover) and the pack-backed session are tested in translation_popover::tests and translation::tests. Remaining limit, kept in the SDK matrix: the engine is a phrase-table pack, not a neural model, and the shell does not yet draw the panel for external apps.

entries.name: TranslationUIServices
entries.note: The service that hosts the translation panel for other apps (a TranslationUIService.appex in the reference): here the same presenter runs in the app process through the SDK, so no separate extension host exists.
entries.ready_note: The reference hosts the panel in an app extension; BifrOSt apps present it in-process through TranslationPresenter, which is what translation_popover::tests and translation::tests exercise. The engine is a phrase-table pack, not a neural model.

entries.name: Transliteration
entries.note: Phonetic transliteration input: Latin letters are composed into script (the reference TransliterationIM input method). Tamil and Devanagari are tabled.
entries.ready_note: The phonetic composer (consonant, inherent vowel, vowel signs, virama, independent vowels) for Tamil and Devanagari is tested in shell::input_methods::indic::tests and runs as an input method in the shell. Other scripts are not tabled.

entries.name: TrustEvaluationAgent
entries.note: Certificate chain evaluation for apps (the trust evaluation agent): validity, host names, CA and path rules, anchors, signature check; network TLS is verified by rustls with the webpki roots.
entries.ready_note: The chain model (ui trust), the SDK SecTrust-style API and the shell trust service with Ed25519 link verification are tested in the three trust::tests modules; TLS connections use rustls with the webpki roots in sdk tls_client. There is no per-user trust-settings daemon or OCSP agent.

entries.name: TrustKit
entries.note: n/a: Apple Mail/Messages ML decisioning. The only resources in the reference index are TrustKitResources/spam_decisioning_logicgraph and spam_filtering_logicgraph (versioned model graphs, 264.0) and an OrderExtraction logic graph under usr/libexec; these are Apple ML model packs for message spam and order detection, not a trust or certificate API.

entries.name: TrustedAccessory
entries.note: n/a: Apple hardware accessory authentication. The index pairs it with System/Library/Extensions/AppleTrustedAccessory.kext, the driver for Apple-certified accessories (authentication coprocessor); Linux has no counterpart and BifrOSt does not mirror Apple accessory authentication.

entries.name: TrustedPeers

entries.name: Tungsten

The index shows only Resources and a default.metallib (Metal shader library, also in the iOSSupport copy), no UI, XPC service or plug-in; it is an Apple GPU/ML shim with an iOS (Catalyst) twin, which BifrOSt does not mirror (its GPU path is Vulkan/Wayland).

entries.name: TuriCore

entries.name: TurnManagerService

entries.name: TypistFramework
entries.note: n/a: Apple internal test tooling. Typist is a keystroke-injection driver for automated typing tests; the index shows only Info.plist and version.plist, no resources or host. BifrOSt drives input in tests through its own SDK testing kit (sdk testing.rs), not an Apple-style test driver.

entries.name: UIRecording
entries.note: n/a: Apple developer UI-test recording. The index shows Info.plist and a large Localizable.loctable (129 KB) and no app or service; UI recording captures interactions to generate automated UI tests for Apple's developer tools. BifrOSt tests its UI with the SDK testing kit (sdk testing.rs) and snapshots, not by recording a session. Evidence is limited to the layout and name; the lead should confirm.

The index shows a bare client framework (Info.plist, version.plist, no resources or UI); it feeds Apple's private network-classification heuristics and is not a function BifrOSt mirrors (network state is in the net modules, no data goes to a vendor). Evidence is the name and the bare layout; the lead should confirm.

entries.name: URLFormatting
entries.note: Address display formatting: the shown form of a URL (scheme, www. and trailing slash dropped) in the address bar, titles and history search.
entries.ready_note: nav::display_url builds the displayed address (tested in shell::browser::nav::tests) and is used for the bar, tab titles and history matching; sdk url_components parses and rebuilds URL parts (url_components::tests).

The SDK matrix already settled USDKit as n/a (docs/parity-matrix/data/usdkit.json: no 3D scene graph or RealityKit stack in BifrOSt); the one USD capability kept is the USDZ package unpacker (springboard/cmd/src/usdextract.rs).

The SDK matrix settled USDKit as n/a (docs/parity-matrix/data/usdkit.json: no 3D scene graph or RealityKit renderer); this Objective-C binding has no Objective-C runtime or scene graph to bind on BifrOSt. USDZ unpacking is covered by springboard/cmd/src/usdextract.rs.

entries.name: USDSync

entries.name: USTBridge
entries.note: n/a: Apple-internal bridge framework. The index shows Info.plist and version.plist only, no UI, strings, plug-in or host bundle, and BifrOSt has no counterpart for the Apple service it fronts. Evidence is the bare layout and the Apple-specific name; the lead should confirm.

entries.name: USTBridgeConnection
entries.note: n/a: the connection half of USTBridge (bare framework, Info.plist only, no resources or host). Same Apple-internal bridge as USTBridge; no BifrOSt counterpart. The lead should confirm.

entries.name: UVCExtension
entries.note: USB Video Class camera support. On Linux the uvcvideo kernel driver exposes the camera as /dev/video*; BifrOSt captures through V4L2 and shows the camera controls.
entries.ready_note: V4L2 probing, mmap streaming and YUYV/NV12/MJPEG conversion (media::v4l2), the camera device list (camera::devices) and camera property controls (ui camera_properties) are tested; the UVC protocol itself is the kernel's uvcvideo driver.

entries.name: UVCFamily
entries.note: The UVC class driver family and its device matching table (UVCMatching.plist). On Linux uvcvideo binds UVC cameras by USB class; BifrOSt lists and opens the resulting V4L2 nodes.
entries.ready_note: Device discovery and capture over the uvcvideo-provided V4L2 nodes are tested in media::v4l2::tests, shell::camera::devices::tests and ui camera_device::tests; class matching is done by the Linux kernel, so no matching table is kept.

entries.name: UVCFrameProcessor
entries.note: Frame conversion for UVC cameras: the camera pixel formats are converted to the shell's RGBA pixels before display.
entries.ready_note: YUYV, NV12, NV21 and MJPEG to RGBA conversion is tested in media::v4l2::tests, and the camera app path that consumes the frames in shell::camera::tests.

entries.name: UVFSXPCService
entries.note: User-space file system service (the UVFS XPC host for FSKit modules): a module describes a volume and the service serves the kernel's requests. Here the kernel side is FUSE through fusermount3.
entries.ready_note: The unary file system dispatcher (lookup, attributes, readdir, read), the FUSE wire decode/reply and the volume model are tested in fs_module::tests, fuse::tests and fs_volume::tests; fuse_mount serves them over a fusermount3 session.

entries.name: UXKit
entries.note: The shared view toolkit under Mac apps (table, collection and layout views). BifrOSt's equivalent is bifrost-ui and the SDK controls, which every shell and app screen is built with.
entries.ready_note: Collection and list content models with selection and layout are tested in ui collection::tests and list_content::tests; the toolkit is bifrost-ui and bifrost_app::controls, so UXKit's job is done by the single UI kit (no separate port layer).

entries.name: UnblockClient

The index shows a bare client framework (Info.plist, version.plist; no UI, strings or host bundle) with the matching service framework, an Apple daemon IPC pair for a service BifrOSt does not mirror. Evidence is the bare layout; the lead should confirm.

entries.name: UnblockService
entries.note: n/a: service half of UnblockClient (bare framework, Info.plist only; no UI, strings, plug-in or host bundle). An Apple daemon IPC pair with no BifrOSt counterpart. The lead should confirm.

entries.name: Uninstall
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs; springboard/src/shell/pacman_update.rs (removable_packages, remove_args, Removal); springboard/src/privd/methods.rs (package.remove); springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (Alert, package_rx); springboard/src/shell/storage_page.rs
entries.note: Store apps are removed by install::uninstall and uninstall_local, which are tested. Built 2026-10-17: Settings > General > Storage lists the removable packages (APPLICATIONS), a tap opens the confirmation alert (Removal), and Remove runs privd package.remove through pacman -R, refusing the shell and the base system (tests pacman_update::tests, storage_page::tests).
entries.ready_note: Storage lists the removable packages, confirms with the alert and removes through privd (guarded pacman -R); the parsing, the refusals and the list rows are tested.

entries.name: UniversalAccess
entries.note: Accessibility settings: Display Zoom, Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, Reduce Transparency, Sticky Keys, and the per-app denial policy (the reference also has an accessibility tutorial and shortcuts extension).
entries.ready_note: The accessibility settings, sticky keys, the per-app universal access policy and the SDK display-accessibility queries are tested; the onboarding tutorial app is not built.

entries.name: UniversalControl
entries.note: Apple safety features (emergency and crash-safety UI) and cross-device Universal Control between Apple devices. Apple hardware or service features with no BifrOSt meaning.

entries.name: UniversalDrag
entries.note: n/a: cross-device drag for Universal Control. The index shows a bare framework with no resources; the host is System/Library/CoreServices/UniversalControl.app with its UniversalControl.framework, an Apple-only Continuity transport that shares one pointer and keyboard across Macs. Same-machine drag and drop is separate and built (ui drag_session, sdk transfer_drag).

entries.name: UniversalHID
entries.note: Generic HID device and report handling. BifrOSt reads HID devices through Linux hidraw/evdev, parses report descriptors and matches devices to drivers.
entries.ready_note: Report descriptor parsing and value extraction (ui hid_report), device matching (ui hid_match) and the SDK device and report APIs are tested.

entries.name: UniversalHIDKit
entries.note: The kit layer over UniversalHID: device enumeration, report parsing and matching for apps. Same BifrOSt code as UniversalHID.
entries.ready_note: The kit and the base layer are one split of the same job; BifrOSt implements it once in sdk hid_devices/hid_reports over ui hid_report/hid_match, tested in those modules.

entries.name: UpdateCycle
entries.note: Automatic update checks: the softwareupdate command reads and sets the background check schedule and reports the update state.
entries.ready_note: Schedule switching, state listing and option parsing for the background update checks are tested in cmd softwareupdate.

entries.name: UpdateCycleSupport
entries.note: Support for the software update cycle: when to check, what to offer and how an update is staged. BifrOSt checks on a schedule through the update agent, notifies, and stages OS updates.
entries.ready_note: The softwareupdate tool (list, install, schedule preference) and the shell OTA path (schedule due-ness on Wi-Fi/charging, notification, staging, checksum) are tested in cmd softwareupdate::tests and shell::ota::tests.

entries.name: UserActivity
entries.note: User activities (what an app is doing so it can be continued or found) and the shared clipboard progress agent. BifrOSt has the activity center and the sealed Universal Clipboard over BifrOSt Cloud.
entries.ready_note: The activity center (make current, replace, invalidate) is tested in user_activity::tests; the account-sealed clipboard policy and cloud transport in universal_clipboard::tests and cloud_clipboard::tests. Apple's device-to-device Handoff transport is not mirrored; activities are local to the session.

entries.name: UserFS
entries.note: The user-space file system daemon (userfsd and userfs_helper) that mounts FSKit modules in the user session. BifrOSt serves modules over FUSE with fusermount3, no daemon needed.
entries.ready_note: Volume dispatch, FUSE protocol and the volume model are tested (fs_module, fuse, fs_volume); fuse_mount performs the unprivileged mount through fusermount3 and serves requests in the app.

entries.name: UserManagement
entries.note: Local user and group management (Users & Groups): list people, add, delete and promote with validation, last-administrator and system-account guards.
entries.ready_note: Name and password validation, passwd/group parsing, admin and delete refusals and the add argv are tested in privd::accounts::tests; the SDK reads the installed account in local_account::tests. Personas (managed multi-user profiles) are not modelled.

Refreshed 2026-10-17: not ready, remaining: No system delivery of camera or screenshot scenes to third-party apps (the core of the framework). | App return path is a model only: sdk visual_search::VisualSearchProvider answers a Scene with Matches, and search() stamps each match with the provider app id (tests in sdk/src/visual_search.rs); the shell does not call it yet. | Scene labels and pixels exist (ui visual_search::Scene::new, with_labels, pixel); the caller supplies the labels, nothing classifies the scene. | Object selection exists as Scene::crop(PixelRect) in ui visual_search; no screenshot UI feeds it yet. | App Intents are not exposed to a Shortcuts app or to a Siri-like assistant; entity queries are reachable only through the control socket and the Spotlight shortcut list.

entries.name: VisualLookUp
entries.note: Apple Visual Look Up and Videos app services (Apple photo and media catalogue, Apple TV videos UI). Apple service with its own model data; BifrOSt has no equivalent catalogue.

entries.name: VisualMediaRetrieval
entries.note: Apple on-device generative and understanding model packs (Apple Intelligence text, token, visual and UI-intelligence models). Model weights and Apple services, not an OS framework BifrOSt can match.

entries.name: VisualPairing
entries.note: Apple accessory firmware-update and pairing services (UARP, accessory pairing). Only meaningful for Apple accessories.

entries.name: VisualTestKit
entries.note: Apple-internal visual regression harness. BifrOSt has its own snapshot kit in springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs.
